## Description

Combines rough path theory with neural differential equations to process high-frequency limit order book data as continuous rough streams, capturing path-dependent volatility and price jumps.

## Where it may fit

High-frequency limit order book forecasting, volatile market regime transitions, path-dependent option execution.

## Vehicles

High-frequency trading (HFT) firms, statistical arbitrage prop desks.

## Required data

Millisecond limit order book level 2/3 message feeds, trade timestamps, quote adjustments.

## Caveats

Requires specialized rough path integration libraries and GPU infrastructure for real-time tick ingestion.
